source_text: Conservative Judaism similarly upholds circumcision as essential to the brit milah rite, with the Rabbinical Assembly's Committee on Jewish Law and Standards affirming it as non-negotiable for covenantal entry, paralleling requirements in conversion processes where even prior circumcision necessitates hatafat dam brit (extraction of a drop of blood). [17]
